lines.text: Today your games will remember things — like the score.
A variable is like a box with a name on it.
The box called score holds a number, like 3.
During the game, the number inside can change.
Set puts a value in the box. We set the score to 0 at the start of every game.
Change adds to the value. Change score by 1 adds one point.
If you forget to set the score at the start, it carries on from the last game.
Always reset your variables when the green flag is clicked.
You can use a variable in a condition. If score equals 10, then you win!
Now add a score to your games in the Code Lab!
